requirement: The system shall provide a web page for submitting domain-generation requests, establish a user session, and accept jobs only after validating that session. Submitted jobs shall be queued through Redis and executed asynchronously by the squatm3 engine.
Users shall be able to supply a domain, select supported variant-generation methods including substitution, flipping, and fast or complete homoglyph generation, and request JSON output.
The system shall deliver job progress and results asynchronously over a WebSocket-compatible channel only to the client session that submitted the corresponding job.
For malformed requests, missing resources, internal server failures, and query-parsing failures, the system shall return human-readable plain-text error messages.
When GoDaddy integration is enabled, the system shall check domain availability using configured credentials and service endpoints, supporting checks for individual domains and batches.
